items.title: Cast float n_ctxs-derived buffer sizes to int
items.criterion: Buffer constructors convert n_ctxs and activation_buffer_size to int, so the default n_ctxs=3e4 no longer makes t.empty raise. This applies to ActivationBuffer, HeadActivationBuffer and NNsightActivationBuffer.

items.title: Buffer __next__ handles exactly one unread activation
items.criterion: All buffer __next__ methods obtain unread indices with nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0] or flatten(), so a single unread row yields a 1-D tensor and len() works.

items.title: Buffer close() closes the real data source, not text_stream
items.criterion: close() in all buffers stops referencing the nonexistent self.text_stream. When self.data exposes close(), it is closed, and calling close() twice is safe.

items.title: remove_bos masks actual BOS tokens instead of dropping column 0
items.criterion: With remove_bos, refresh removes positions where input_ids == bos_token_id, combined with the attention mask, instead of slicing column 0. The result is correct under left padding.

items.title: remove_bos fallback for tokenizers without a BOS token
items.criterion: When bos_token_id is None and remove_bos is set, the buffer warns and removes the first non-pad token of each sequence. The first-token position is computed from the cumulative sum of the attention mask.

items.title: HeadActivationBuffer saves hidden states when apply_W_O=False
items.criterion: HeadActivationBuffer.refresh calls .save() on hidden states in both apply_W_O branches and uses .value after the trace, so indexing by attention mask works.

items.title: from_pretrained uses map_location and always applies dtype
items.criterion: Every from_pretrained loads with map_location (CPU or the target device) and always applies the requested dtype, even when device is None. This covers AutoEncoder, Gated, New, JumpReLU, TopK, BatchTopK and Matryoshka.

items.title: Make from_pretrained a classmethod using cls
items.criterion: GatedAutoEncoder, AutoEncoderNew and AutoEncoderTopK declare from_pretrained with @classmethod, take cls as the first argument, and construct with cls(...).

items.title: JumpReluAutoEncoder.from_pretrained honors requested device
items.criterion: The inverted `if device is not None` override is removed or corrected. The loaded model is moved once, to the caller-supplied device and dtype.

items.title: PAnneal/GatedAnneal resampling actually writes parameters
items.criterion: resample_neurons stops assigning through chained advanced indexing such as weight[deads][:n]. It builds explicit dead indices and assigns in place, and a test confirms the weights change.

items.title: GatedAnneal resampling matches gated architecture parameters
items.criterion: GatedAnnealTrainer.resample_neurons no longer accesses encoder.bias. For dead features it resets gate_bias, mag_bias, r_mag and the encoder/decoder columns.

items.title: Reset Adam state by parameter object, not numeric IDs
items.criterion: Resampling code resets exp_avg and exp_avg_sq through optimizer.state[param] along the correct feature dimension, instead of hard-coded state_dict indices 1/2/3. This applies in the Standard, PAnneal and GatedAnneal trainers.

items.title: Matryoshka reconstruction loss uses the weighted sum
items.criterion: MatryoshkaBatchTopKTrainer.loss trains on total_l2_loss, the group-weighted sum, rather than taking mean() of already-weighted losses. Per-group values are kept only for logging.

items.title: JumpReLU L0 surrogate applied to pre_jump
items.criterion: JumpReluTrainer.loss passes pre_jump, not the thresholded f, to StepFunction.apply.

items.title: p-annealing never reaches p=0 with constant or inf loss
items.criterion: Either the p schedule excludes p_end as documented or p_end > 0 is validated, so neither f.pow(0) nor pow(1/0) is computed. Alternatively, a documented L0 endpoint using f != 0 is implemented.

items.title: Allocate num_tokens_since_fired on self.device
items.criterion: The TopK, BatchTopK and Matryoshka trainers allocate the dead-feature counter with device=self.device rather than the raw device argument.

items.title: TopK update_threshold avoids infinite thresholds
items.criterion: update_threshold averages only finite positive row minima. When none exist, it skips the update, so the threshold never becomes inf.

items.title: geometric_median guards against zero distances
items.criterion: Distances in geometric_median are clamped with an eps, or zero-distance points are handled explicitly, so identical or duplicate points no longer produce NaN.

items.title: Deduplicate geometric_median implementations
items.criterion: The staticmethod copies in batch_top_k and matryoshka are removed in favour of one shared function.

items.title: norm_factor persisted to saved config
items.criterion: norm_factor is computed before config.json is written. It is explicitly included in the saved JSON and wandb config instead of being assigned into the transient trainer.config dict.

items.title: trainSAE does not mutate caller trainer_configs
items.criterion: trainSAE copies each config before deleting 'trainer' or editing wandb_name, so the caller's dicts are unchanged after the call.

items.title: Validate log_steps when logging is enabled
items.criterion: trainSAE raises a clear error, or picks a default, when use_wandb or verbose is set and log_steps is None, instead of failing on `step % None`.

items.title: Verbose log_stats works in transcoder mode
items.criterion: In transcoder mode, the verbose print no longer references an undefined frac_variance_explained.

items.title: get_norm_factor processes exactly `steps` batches
items.criterion: The loop break condition is `step >= steps`, so exactly steps batches are consumed. The consumption of batches from the buffer is documented.

items.title: ConstrainedAdam skips parameters without gradients
items.criterion: ConstrainedAdam.step skips constrained params whose grad is None instead of raising a TypeError.

items.title: ConstrainedAdam guards zero-norm columns
items.criterion: Norm divisions in ConstrainedAdam (gradient projection and renormalization) are clamped with an eps, so zero columns do not produce NaN.

items.title: get_lr_schedule handles warmup_steps=0 with resampling
items.criterion: The resample branch of get_lr_schedule returns 1.0, or equivalent, when warmup_steps == 0 instead of raising ZeroDivisionError.

items.title: loss_recovered masks CE loss using the attention mask
items.criterion: loss_recovered computes unreduced shifted cross-entropy and masks it with the attention mask, rather than ignore_index=pad_token_id. This works when pad_token_id is None or equals EOS, and targets are moved to the logits device.

items.title: evaluate cossim and l2_ratio guard zero norms
items.criterion: The cossim and l2_ratio denominators are clamped with an eps, or zero vectors are handled explicitly, so zero inputs or zero reconstructions produce no NaN.

items.title: Guard frac_recovered and variance-explained denominators
items.criterion: frac_recovered, frac_variance_explained and relative_reconstruction_bias handle zero denominators with an eps or a documented sentinel instead of returning inf or NaN.

items.title: frac_alive counts nonzero activity, not signed sums
items.criterion: evaluate accumulates (features != 0).any(dim=0) across batches with a logical OR to determine alive features.

items.title: normalize_decoder uses the decoder's device and dtype under no_grad
items.criterion: AutoEncoder.normalize_decoder creates test_input with the device and dtype of decoder.weight and runs under torch.no_grad().

items.title: examine_dimension works when dim_idx is None
items.criterion: The random dim_idx is drawn from dictionary.dict_size or a known dimension before activations is referenced. No UnboundLocalError or NameError is raised.

items.title: feature_umap handles int and None feat_idxs
items.criterion: feature_umap normalizes an int feat_idxs to a list and defines colors in that case. With feat_idxs=None it does not evaluate `i not in None`, using a single if/elif/else chain.

items.title: grad_pursuit step size safe for zero direction
items.criterion: _grad_pursuit_update_step clamps or skips the <c,c> denominator, so a fully explained residual does not produce NaN weights.

items.title: grad_pursuit allocates tensors matching the signal
items.criterion: Weights and intermediates are allocated with signal.device and signal.dtype, for example via signal.new_zeros, rather than a separate device argument and float32.

items.title: Declare torch as a direct dependency
items.criterion: pyproject.toml lists torch with a supported version range.

items.title: Fix README trainer source links
items.criterion: README trainer links point to dictionary_learning/trainers/*.py paths that exist.

items.title: README training example is runnable with required args
items.criterion: The README training example passes the required steps, layer and lm_name arguments (plus warmup), and uses an integer n_ctxs with consistent batch sizes, so it runs as written.

items.title: HeadActivationBuffer stores activations in the model dtype
items.criterion: HeadActivationBuffer activation storage and hidden_states_W_O are allocated with the captured activation or model dtype, not a float32 default.

items.title: NNsightActivationBuffer tokenized_batch no longer tokenizes token tensors
items.criterion: tokenized_batch either returns token_batch() directly or is removed. The token-returning text_batch is renamed or documented so that evaluate does not treat it as text.

items.title: NNsightActivationBuffer excludes padding positions
items.criterion: NNsightActivationBuffer.refresh applies the attention mask to input and output activations, so padded positions are excluded. A test uses unequal-length sequences.

items.title: BatchTopK/Matryoshka threshold updated in place as a tensor
items.criterion: update_threshold writes via self.ae.threshold.fill_() or copy_(), keeping the buffer's dtype and device, instead of assigning a Python float to the registered buffer.

items.title: TopKTrainer logging works when auxk_alpha == 0
items.criterion: auxk_loss is a tensor, or is converted with float(), so the logging path does not call .item() on the Python int 0.

items.title: Geometric-median b_dec init preserves device and dtype
items.criterion: x is moved to self.device before geometric_median, and b_dec is updated with b_dec.data.copy_(median), so b_dec keeps its device and dtype in all three trainers.

items.title: Custom JumpReLU autograd reduces threshold gradient to shape F
items.criterion: JumpReLUFunction.backward and StepFunction.backward sum the threshold gradient over broadcast batch dimensions to match the threshold's shape. Bandwidth is saved via x.new_tensor.

items.title: JumpReluTrainer applies seed
items.criterion: JumpReluTrainer.__init__ calls t.manual_seed(seed) when seed is given.

items.title: JumpReluTrainer loss respects apply_b_dec_to_input
items.criterion: pre_jump in the loss is computed with the same b_dec logic as JumpReluAutoEncoder.encode, either by reusing encode or by honouring apply_b_dec_to_input.

items.title: anneal_end defaults to steps-1 with range validation
items.criterion: anneal_end defaults to steps-1, and __init__ asserts anneal_start < anneal_end <= steps-1 in both p-anneal trainers.

items.title: p-annealing update steps are unique
items.criterion: The integer sparsity_update_steps schedule contains no duplicates, so p transitions are not skipped or repeated and p_step_count cannot overflow.

items.title: Adaptive sparsity coefficient update is queue-safe
items.criterion: The coefficient update skips the step when the loss queue is empty or the old loss is zero, avoiding division by zero.

items.title: Validate Matryoshka group fractions and weights
items.criterion: MatryoshkaBatchTopKTrainer.__init__ raises clear errors when any group size is 0, when len(group_weights) != len(group_fractions), or when any weight is negative.

items.title: Validate k <= dict_size for top-k SAEs
items.criterion: The TopK, BatchTopK and Matryoshka constructors reject k > dict_size, with boundary tests.

items.title: Don't cast activations to autocast dtype on CPU
items.criterion: trainSAE casts activations to autocast_dtype only when autocast is active; otherwise it casts to the parameter dtype. bf16 training on CPU then avoids dtype mismatches.

items.title: Skip CUDA autocast for float32
items.criterion: trainSAE uses nullcontext when autocast_dtype is float32 and validates the allowed CUDA autocast dtypes.

items.title: Logging does not alter training state
items.criterion: The log_stats metrics path does not update dead-feature counters, thresholds, p-annealing queues or step counters, so logging frequency does not change results.

items.title: trainSAE returns trained trainers or dictionaries
items.criterion: trainSAE returns the trainers or their .ae modules, consistent with README usage of `ae = trainSAE(...)`.

items.title: Variance explained computed over flattened samples
items.criterion: evaluate and log_stats flatten leading dimensions to N x D and use correction=0, so B x L x D inputs and single-sample batches are handled correctly.

items.title: loss_recovered uses the same tracer_args for every run
items.criterion: The original, reconstructed and zero-ablation traces all receive the same tracer_args. Tuple detection uses the real trace rather than a separate probe trace.

items.title: grad_pursuit does not reselect already chosen atoms
items.criterion: Already selected atoms are masked before argmax, iteration stops when no improving atom remains, and target_l0 > dict_size is rejected.

items.title: Head/NNsight buffers capped at configured capacity
items.criterion: The refresh methods of HeadActivationBuffer and NNsightActivationBuffer slice the final batch to the remaining capacity, as ActivationBuffer does.

items.title: Buffer read masks allocated on buffer device
items.criterion: Initial read masks are created on self.device, so indexing them against CUDA activations works.

items.title: Refresh detects exhausted or non-producing data
items.criterion: Refresh loops detect when a batch makes zero progress or the iterator is exhausted. They raise a clear error, or keep the partial batch, instead of looping forever or silently dropping data.

items.title: Validate buffer constructor sizes are positive
items.criterion: The buffers reject non-positive ctx_len, refresh_batch_size, out_batch_size, d_submodule and capacity values.

items.title: get_norm_factor validates steps and empty data
items.criterion: get_norm_factor asserts steps > 0 and raises a clear error when no batches were observed, instead of dividing by zero.

items.title: normalize_decoder handles zero decoder columns
items.criterion: Zero-norm decoder columns are clamped or validated during normalize_decoder, so no division by zero occurs.

items.title: LR schedules clamped to [0,1]
items.criterion: The standard-decay and repeating schedules never return negative factors past total_steps.

items.title: ConstrainedAdam.step returns super().step result
items.criterion: ConstrainedAdam.step returns the value from super().step(closure), preserving standard optimizer closure semantics.

items.title: Unit tests for lr schedule and sparsity warmup
items.criterion: Tests cover every branch of get_lr_schedule and get_sparsity_warmup_fn, including warmup_steps=0.

items.title: One-step update tests for every trainer
items.criterion: CPU unit tests run update() once for each trainer on random data and assert that constrained decoder norms stay at 1.

items.title: State-dict round-trip tests for TopK-style SAEs
items.criterion: Tests save and reload AutoEncoderTopK, BatchTopKSAE and MatryoshkaBatchTopKSAE, and check that scale_biases scales the threshold.

items.title: End-to-end tests skip without CUDA/network and are independent
items.criterion: test_end_to_end is marked skip when CUDA or network access is unavailable, and test_evaluation no longer depends on test_sae_training outputs.

items.title: README trainer class names and module locations correct
items.criterion: README names TopKTrainer and BatchTopKTrainer correctly, places ConstrainedAdam in trainers/trainer.py, and drops the unsupported 'in_to_out' io mode and the --checkpoints flag.

items.title: Remove dead did_fire code in JumpReluTrainer
items.criterion: The unused did_fire computation is removed from JumpReluTrainer.loss.

items.title: Plain-PyTorch activation buffer using forward hooks
items.criterion: A new ActivationBuffer works with HF models without nnsight. It captures submodule activations via a forward hook that raises an early-stop exception, and removes the hook in finally.

items.title: Model truncation and submodule lookup utilities
items.criterion: utils provides get_submodule and truncate_model, which remove layers after the target layer for supported architectures (Qwen2, Gemma2, etc.).

items.title: Support Qwen3 in get_submodule and truncate_model
items.criterion: Qwen3ForCausalLM is handled in both utils functions, like Qwen2 and Gemma2.

items.title: End-to-end test for the PyTorch buffer path
items.criterion: tests/test_pytorch_end_to_end.py trains SAEs using pytorch_buffer.ActivationBuffer and checks the results.

items.title: Mixed pretrain/chat dataset generator with sequence packing
items.criterion: utils provides hf_mixed_dataset_to_generator, which mixes pretrain and chat data at a configurable fraction. It supports min_chars packing joined by EOS and optional system-prompt removal.

items.title: add_special_tokens option for buffer tokenization
items.criterion: ActivationBuffer accepts add_special_tokens, passes it to the tokenizer, and traces on the pre-tokenized batch.

items.title: Optional mask for high-norm activation outliers
items.criterion: Both buffers accept max_activation_norm_multiple and drop activations whose norm exceeds that multiple of the batch median norm.

items.title: Resumable backup checkpoints via backup_steps
items.criterion: trainSAE accepts backup_steps. Every backup_steps steps it saves step, ae state, optimizer state, config and norm_factor to save_dir/ae.pt.

items.title: Optional k-annealing for top-k trainers
items.criterion: The TopK, BatchTopK and Matryoshka trainers accept k_anneal_steps and linearly anneal the SAE's k buffer from activation_dim down to the target k, updating it in place, with validation.

items.title: IdentityDict handles device and dtype
items.criterion: IdentityDict accepts dtype and device and casts inputs in encode, decode and forward. from_pretrained constructs it with activation_dim, device and dtype.

items.title: README documents utils.load_dictionary and Matryoshka trainer
items.criterion: README shows loading any architecture with utils.load_dictionary and lists MatryoshkaBatchTopKTrainer among the trainers.
